Stacks expire one by one every second when the duration ends.@@description2@@'''Active:''' For 6 seconds, '''Ashe''' gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed and empowers her basic attacks to fire a flurry of five arrows that deal '''modified''' physical damage. The flurries [[:Life steal|apply]] [[File:Life steal icon.svg|15px|link=Life steal]] life steal and ''[[File:Ashe Frost Shot.png|20xpx|border|link=Ashe#Frost Shot|An icon for Ashe's ability Frost Shot]] [[Ashe#Frost Shot|Frost Shot]]'' per arrow, but apply [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects only once.@@description3@@{{{description3}}}@@description4@@''Ranger's Focus [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Ashe's''' basic attack timer.''@@description5@@{{{description5}}}@@description6@@{{{description6}}}@@leveling@@{{{leveling}}}@@leveling2@@

20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60%
'''Physical Damage Per Arrow:'''
22 / 23 / 24 / 25 / 26% AD
'''Total Damage Per Flurry:'''
110 / 115 / 120 / 125 / 130% AD

flurries deal 1 instance of [[File:Basic Attack.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Basic damage]] [[:Damage|basic damage]] followed by 4 instances of a non-reactive type of damage (either [[File:Minion Dematerializer rune.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Default damage]] [[:Damage|default]] or [[File:Wit's End item.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Proc damage]] [[:Damage|proc]]). ** The flurries are classified as a basic attack on a [[:Damage|script]] level, but are considered an ability for other effects (e.g. [[File:Maokai OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Maokai|An icon representing Maokai]] [[Maokai|Maokai's]] [[File:Maokai Sap Magic.png|20xpx|border|link=Maokai#Sap Magic|An icon for Maokai's ability Sap Magic]] [[Maokai#Sap Magic|Sap Magic]]).(bug) * The first flurry of a ''Ranger's Focus'' cast fires「 one additional arrow, dealing 20% increased total damage. 」「 six arrows, dealing a total of 132 / 138 / 144 / 150 / 156% attack damage. 」 * ''Ranger's Focus'' works against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]]. * Flat damage reductions (e.g. [[File:Amumu OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Amumu|An icon representing Amumu]] [[Amumu|Amumu's]] [[File:Amumu Tantrum.png|20xpx|border|link=Amumu#Tantrum|An icon for Amumu's ability Tantrum]] [[Amumu#Tantrum|Tantrum]], [[File:Fizz OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Fizz|An icon representing Fizz]] [[Fizz|Fizz's]] [[File:Fizz Nimble Fighter.png|20xpx|border|link=Fizz#Nimble Fighter|An icon for Fizz's ability Nimble Fighter]] [[Fizz#Nimble Fighter|Nimble Fighter]], or [[File:Leona OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Leona|An icon representing Leona]] [[Leona|Leona's]] [[File:Leona Eclipse.png|20xpx|border|link=Leona#Eclipse|An icon for Leona's ability Eclipse]] [[Leona#Eclipse|Eclipse]]) apply per arrow, resulting in extremely increased effectiveness against ''Ranger's Focus''. ** The sole exception is [[File:Warden's Mail item.png|20xpx|border|link=Warden's Mail|An icon for the item Warden's Mail]] [[Warden's Mail|Warden's Mail's]] [[Named item effect#Rock Solid|Rock Solid]], as that applies per [[:Champion ability|cast instance]] rather than per damage instance. * A flurry can apply 5 stacks of [[File:Black Cleaver item.png|20xpx|border|link=Black Cleaver|An icon for the item Black Cleaver]] [[Black Cleaver|Black Cleaver's]] [[Named item effect#Carve|Carve]] to a single target as it deals 5 instances of physical damage. * ''Ranger's Focus'' also empowers [[File:Runaan's Hurricane item.png|20xpx|border|link=Runaan's Hurricane|An icon for the item Runaan's Hurricane]] [[Runaan's Hurricane|Runaan's Hurricane's]] [[Named item effect#Wind's Fury|Wind's Fury]] bolts to become a flurry of 5 bolts each as well. ** The empowered bolts use '''Ashe's''' attack projectile, including her missile speed (2500 compared to their default 2000). ** The bolts are evenly distributed among the targets, but a single target cannot be hit by more than 5 bolts. ** These flurries also apply [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects only once to each target hit. * Because ''Focus'' stacks are generated [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]], [[File:Runaan's Hurricane item.png|20xpx|border|link=Runaan's Hurricane|An icon for the item Runaan's Hurricane]] [[Runaan's Hurricane|Runaan's Hurricane's]] [[Named item effect#Wind's Fury|Wind's Fury's]] bolts will not generate any.@@
